lead_time_days.reason: Parts (2-5 days) and the backplane PCB fabrication (5-12 days) in parallel, then 2 printing day(s) for 26.3 h of sliced print time, 1-2 day(s) assembly, flashing and test, a 0-2 day remake buffer, and 2-6 courier days. Every duration is an assumption, not a supplier commitment; the courier window needs the delivery pincode.

steady_state.reason: stocked parts and backplanes: printing, assembly and test, buffer and courier only

inputs.assembly_ops_basis: ASSUMPTION: same operation set as the sim (sim-assumptions.json assembly.minutes_per_op); counts come from this design: one module_install per mounted module, one cable_route per 3 harness cables (minimum 1), one insert_heatset per heat-set insert in the hardware list

box_cm.basis: assembly bounding box [142, 110, 188] mm + 40 mm padding per side (ASSUMPTION: outer box = assembly bounding box + 40 mm padding per side (the sim used a fixed 22 x 18 x 20 cm box for a 108 x 78 x 124 mm robot))

packed_weight_kg.basis: sliced plastic 293 g + electronics and box allowances (ASSUMPTION, see gstudio-assumptions.json)

bureau_fdm_inr.basis: RESEARCH: IamRapid published FDM PLA 3-5 per cm3 (india_landscape.md line 75) - used only as a cross-check

limits: Every rupee is a planning range or a labelled assumption, not a supplier quote; no contract or rate card exists yet (blueprint §7.1).
Courier cost and delivery window assume an Indian destination; the pincode is unknown.
GST is applied at 18% as an assumption; the product's HSN classification needs a tax adviser (blueprint §8.7).
Print cost uses the sliced grams and hours of a generic 0.4 mm FDM profile; a print bureau's own slicer will differ.
